title: West Coast Labor Day fires
subtitle: September 12, 2020
description: Wind-driven fires in Oregon, California and Washington blanketed the West Coast in dense smoke; Portland, Seattle and San Francisco recorded hazardous PM2.5.
sources: NOAA Hazard Mapping System (HMS) smoke polygons
